SELECT 
    outer_pair.1 AS match_type,
    -- 3. The ratio (exact_matches / total) expressed as a decimal between 0.0 and 1.0
    avg(JSONExtractString(inner_pair.2, 'exact_match') = 'true') AS exact_match_ratio
FROM "default"."redis_json"
-- 1. Parse the target object straight into a ClickHouse Map (String -> String)
ARRAY JOIN JSONExtract(
    JSONExtractRaw(content, 'proposed_to_actual_resolution_diffs'), 
    'Map(String, String)'
) AS outer_pair
-- 2. Take the value of the outer map (which is the inner JSON) and explode its pairs
ARRAY JOIN JSONExtractKeysAndValuesRaw(outer_pair.2) AS inner_pair
where inner_pair.1 = 'include_blank_lines'
GROUP BY 
    outer_pair.1
order by exact_match_ratio

with base as (
    SELECT * FROM "default"."redis_json"
    where startsWith(key, 'evaluation:merge:schesch')
    and content.human.compilation_failed = false
    and content.human.test_execution_failed = false
    and content.human.timed_out = false
    and content.proposed.timed_out = false
)
select
    sum(case when content.proposed.compilation_failed::boolean then 1 else 0 end)/count(*) as compilation_failures,
    sum(case when content.proposed.test_execution_failed::boolean then 1 else 0 end)/count(*) as test_failures
from base
--select content.proposed.timed_out, content.human.compilation_failed, content.proposed.compilation_failed, content.human.test_execution_failed, content.proposed.test_execution_failed, content.human.passed, content.proposed.passed from base

WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
        key,
        logical_conflict.logical_conflict_index AS conflict_index,
        arrayStringConcat(logical_conflict.agent_classifications, '\n') AS agentClassification,
        arrayStringConcat(logical_conflict.human_classifications, '\n') AS humanClassification,
        
        -- Secure array mapping out of Dynamic JSON tracking
        CAST(
            arrayZip(logical_conflict.agent_classifications, logical_conflict.human_classifications),
            'Array(Tuple(String, String))'
        ) AS zipped_classifications
    FROM "default"."redis_json"
    ARRAY JOIN content.logical_conflicts::Array(JSON) AS logical_conflict
    WHERE key LIKE 'evaluation:merge:classification:%'
)
SELECT
    key,
    
    -- Mode 0: Original check (Canonical mismatch)
    max(
        agentClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND 
        humanClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND
        arrayExists(t -> (
            t.1 IN ('CHUNK_CANONICAL_OURS', 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_THEIRS', 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_BASE') AND
            t.2 IN ('CHUNK_CANONICAL_OURS', 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_THEIRS', 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_BASE') AND
            t.1 != t.2
        ), zipped_classifications)
    ) AS canonical_contradiction,

    -- Mode 1: Canonical vs Semicanonical Contradiction (e.g., One picked OURS, other dropped it for BASE/THEIRS)
    max(
        agentClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND 
        humanClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND
        arrayExists(t -> (
            (t.1 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_OURS'   AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_BASETHEIRS') OR
            (t.2 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_OURS'   AND t.1 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_BASETHEIRS') OR
            (t.1 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_THEIRS' AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSBASE')   OR
            (t.2 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_THEIRS' AND t.1 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSBASE')   OR
            (t.1 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_BASE'   AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSTHEIRS') OR
            (t.2 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_BASE'   AND t.1 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSTHEIRS')
        ), zipped_classifications)
    ) AS semicanonical_contradiction,

    -- Mode 3: Asymmetric Ghost Resolutions (One kept history, one completely emptied logic)
    max(
        agentClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND 
        humanClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND
        arrayExists(t -> (
            (t.1 LIKE 'CHUNK_%CANONICAL%' AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_EMPTY') or
            (t.2 LIKE 'CHUNK_%CANONICAL%' AND t.1 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_EMPTY')
        ), zipped_classifications)
    ) AS ghost_resolution,

    -- Mode 4: Heuristic Fallback Breakdown (The agent resolved structurally, human resorted to raw text)
    max(
        agentClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND 
        humanClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND
        arrayExists(t -> (
            (t.1 LIKE 'CHUNK_%CANONICAL%' AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_NONCANONICAL')
        ), zipped_classifications)
    ) AS missed_noncanonical_necessity

FROM base
GROUP BY key
ORDER BY 
    canonical_contradiction DESC, 
    semicanonical_contradiction DESC, 
    ghost_resolution DESC, 
    missed_noncanonical_necessity DESC

with
  base as (
    SELECT
      arrayElement (splitByString ('resolution:conflict:', key), 2) as resolution,
      extractGroups (
        arrayElement (splitByString ('resolution:conflict:', key), 2),
        '(.+)\.git-([a-f0-9]{40}):(.*)$'
      ) AS groups,
      content.proposed_resolution.error
    FROM
      "default"."redis_json"
    where
      startsWith (key, 'resolution')
      and content.proposed_resolution.error is not null
    order by
      content.resolution_end::datetime desc
  )
SELECT
  concat(groups[1], '.git') AS repo_name,
  groups[2] AS merge,
  groups[3] AS timestamp,
  content.proposed_resolution.error,
  'Show Details' as details
from
  base;
SELECT sum(case when content.proposed_resolution.error is not null then 1 else 0 end)/count(*) FROM "default"."redis_json" where startsWith(key, 'resolution')

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    key,
    extractGroups (
      arrayElement(splitByString('resolution:conflict:', key), 2),
      '(.+)\.git-([a-f0-9]{40}):(.*)$'
    ) AS groups
  FROM
    "default"."redis_json"
  WHERE
    startsWith(key, 'resolution')
    AND content.proposed_resolution.error IS NULL
)
SELECT
  concat(groups[1], '.git') AS repo_name,
  groups[2] AS merge,
  MAX(groups[3]) AS timestamp, -- Keeps the latest timestamp for the merge group
  COUNT(evaluation.key) AS total_evaluations,
  'Show Details' AS details,    -- Retains the static string
  
  -- Complete Merge Ratio (Evaluations with incomplete_merge = 0 / Total Evaluations)
  CASE 
    WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN evaluation.key = '' then -1 else 0 end) = -1 THEN -1
    ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN evaluation.key != '' AND evaluation.content.incomplete_merge = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
         / COUNT(evaluation.key)
  END AS complete_merge_ratio,

  -- Exact Match Ratio (Evaluations with perfect_match != 0 / Total Evaluations)
  CASE 
    WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN evaluation.key = '' then -1 else 0 end) = -1 THEN -1
    ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN evaluation.key != '' AND evaluation.content.perfect_match != 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
         / COUNT(evaluation.key)
  END AS exact_match_ratio

FROM
  base b
  LEFT JOIN default.redis_json AS evaluation ON evaluation.key = concat(
    'evaluation:merge:core:',
    concat(b.groups[1], '.git'),
    '-',
    b.groups[2],
    ':',
    b.groups[3]
  )
GROUP BY
  repo_name,
  merge;

select count(*) as "Resolution Count" from default.redis_json
where startsWith(key, 'resolution')

select 
    sum(content.resolution_end::datetime - content.configuration.resolution_start::datetime) as "Total Resolution Time"
from default.redis_json
where startsWith(key, 'resolution')
